source: a fun little game with a big playground and a food store with an arcade that you can play. you can play a game that lets you fly to an obby that you haft to complete. in the playground there will be 2 kids that you haft to talk to and give them 2 burgers and the place is called Jim's playground with a monkey next to it holding a burger

image_prompt.text: A big open playground as the central gathering space that the rest of the place is arranged around
A monkey holding a burger standing next to the playground as its mascot landmark
An arcade cabinet inside the food store that acts as the portal, flying the player out to the obby
A chain of platforms forming the obby the player has to complete once they fly across
A food store with a visible storefront and a counter serving burgers
An arcade attached to the food store, filled with playable arcade machines
Two kids standing in the playground who can be talked to

layout_placement.text: Paired markers taking the player from the arcade machine to the start of the obby
Interaction points on the two kids for handing over two burgers

notes: The obby is a genuinely separate map reached by a portal, so P4 stands alongside the obby's P6.
Entertainment is dominant because the playground and store are the place; the obby is one destination off it.
No option covers NPCs, a shop counter, or arcade cabinets - all carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: Should the obby be its own separate place, or a section of the same map you fly across to?
What happens after the obby is finished - back to the playground, or a reward there?
How big is the playground meant to feel: a backyard, or a whole park?

coverage_missing.ask: Should the obby be its own separate place, or a section of the same map you fly across to?

answers.ask: Should the obby be its own separate place, or a section of the same map you fly across to?
answers.answer: Make the obby a section of the same map that players fly across to.

answers.ask: What happens after the obby is finished - back to the playground, or a reward there?
answers.answer: After finishing the obby, players return to the playground; no extra reward is needed.

answers.ask: How big is the playground meant to feel: a backyard, or a whole park?
answers.answer: It should feel like a whole park, with the food store and arcade included in the playground area.
